notes: The verdict and key measurements are accurate, with useful checks that preserve the limits of the evidence.

defects.quote: The diagnostic pipeline found no candidate episodes to test
defects.why: Zero anomaly tests do not establish that the pipeline found no candidates.

defects.quote: Latency and resource statistics are window-level aggregates (interval means)
defects.why: The latency statistics are window percentiles and maxima, not interval means.

notes: The operator advice is useful, but it overstates what the diagnostic count reveals.

defects.quote: without verified clock alignment any temporal ordering or trend interpretation is unsupported
defects.why: Cross-source clock alignment is unnecessary to interpret a trend within the resource series itself.

defects.quote: No explicit resource or business policy was configured for either window
defects.why: NO_POLICY establishes that no applicable rule was evaluated, not whether policies were configured.

defects.quote: one pair was tested (pair-00) involving one resource metric (resource-00) and one transaction label ('request')
defects.why: The correlation pair does not identify a transaction label, so its attribution to 'request' is unsupported.

defects.quote: Resource-binding evidence/2 spans the full 360 s run
defects.why: The binding ends at 1767225960000, while the run ends 212 ms later.

notes: It retains the main verdict and measurements but makes misleading claims about configuration, correlation scope, and time coverage.

defects.quote: the empty findings reflect that no policy evaluation was configured
defects.why: The evidence establishes no applicable evaluated rule, not that policy evaluation was unconfigured.

defects.quote: a fairly steady ~50% utilization ratio under a constant 20 requests/s load with no detected episodes, which indicates stable observed behavior
defects.why: The resource metric is an unspecified ratio, varies substantially, and had zero anomaly tests, so this stability conclusion is unsupported.

defects.quote: findings are empty because policy evaluation was not configured
defects.why: The evidence does not establish that policy evaluation was unconfigured or that this caused the empty findings.
The aggregates and zero anomaly tests do not establish stable behavior.

defects.quote: Zero errors were observed, but only within a 6-minute window
defects.why: Zero errors are also reported for the whole run, which extends beyond the 6-minute windows.

defects.quote: a complete flat series at ~0.5 ratio
defects.why: The resource series is complete but not flat: its reported values range from about 0.30 to 0.70.

notes: Its main figures are correct, but it repeatedly treats unsupported configuration and stability interpretations as facts.
